rules.name: provider neutral source separation contract
rules.requirement: Source-separation contracts MUST remain provider-neutral; provider names are implementation metadata only.

rules.name: explicit stem capability declaration
rules.requirement: Providers MUST explicitly declare supported stems and stem maturity.

rules.name: unsupported stem fail closed
rules.requirement: Requests for unsupported stems MUST fail closed.

rules.name: experimental stem not production promoted
rules.requirement: Experimental stems MUST NOT satisfy production promotion without explicit quality evidence and promotion.

rules.name: model variant typed artifact
rules.requirement: Every model variant MUST have a distinct typed artifact identity.

rules.name: quantization creates distinct artifact
rules.requirement: Quantized weights MUST be represented as a distinct model artifact, not a hidden flag on the base model.

rules.name: chunk segment policy explicit
rules.requirement: Chunk/segment processing policy MUST be explicit and recorded in execution evidence.

rules.name: overlap reconstruction policy explicit
rules.requirement: Overlap/reconstruction policy MUST be explicit and recorded in execution evidence.

rules.name: resource quality tradeoff evidenced
rules.requirement: Resource-to-quality trade-offs MUST be surfaced as evidence rather than hidden provider behavior.

rules.name: provider cannot own device placement
rules.requirement: Audio-separation providers MUST NOT own host device placement.

rules.name: hrb lease required for accelerator
rules.requirement: Accelerator execution MUST be backed by a valid Host Resource Broker lease.

rules.name: audio normalization typed
rules.requirement: Samplerate, channels, bit depth/representation and codec normalization MUST be typed.

rules.name: clipping policy explicit
rules.requirement: Clipping behavior MUST be an explicit policy decision.

rules.name: derived two stem lineage required
rules.requirement: Derived two-stem outputs MUST retain lineage to the full separation or source mixture and derivation method.

rules.name: model bag first class artifact
rules.requirement: Model ensembles/bags MUST be first-class model artifacts including members, weights and segment policy.

rules.name: long running separation cancellable
rules.requirement: Long-running separation MUST support bounded cancellation/abort semantics.

rules.name: inference training dependency surfaces separated
rules.requirement: Inference, training and quantization dependency surfaces MUST be separable.

rules.name: stem output first class artifact with provenance
rules.requirement: Each output stem MUST be a first-class media artifact with identity, provenance, parent-mixture relation and output hash.

rules.name: model container safety is not execution safety
rules.requirement: A safe weight container format MUST NOT by itself authorize model execution; artifact provenance, admission, architecture implementation and execution policy MUST also pass.

rules.name: external model metadata class allowlist
rules.requirement: External model metadata MUST NOT select arbitrary local runtime classes/modules; class resolution MUST use an allowlisted registry implementation mapping.
